public/vendor/azure-logo.svg — the Azure mark used on the film thumbnail (`--mark azure`)
=========================================================================================

WHAT IT IS
  Microsoft's "Azure A" icon (10018-icon-service-Azure-A), from the Azure Architecture Icons set.
  Used by scripts/thumb-film.mjs for `--mark azure`, embedded AS SUPPLIED: never recoloured,
  re-traced, re-proportioned or otherwise altered.

WHERE IT CAME FROM
  Extracted on 2026-11-02 from @threeveloper/azure-react-icons 1.1.1 (MIT, Sjoerd van Bommel),
  graphl-flow's own icon dependency, which repackages the icons ZIP that Microsoft publishes at
  https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/icons/ . The paths and gradients are the
  component's, rendered to static SVG with react-dom/server. Two changes were made to the <svg>
  element only, not to the mark: a `viewBox="0 0 18 18"` matching its own 18x18 size, and the
  component's `fill="currentColor"` default was removed (every path carries its own fill).

  The MIT licence covers the React wrapper, not the icon. The icon is Microsoft's.

THE TERMS THAT APPLY
  Microsoft's icon page states that it permits these icons in architectural diagrams, training
  materials and documentation; that they may be copied, distributed and displayed only for that
  use unless Microsoft grants explicit permission; and that they must not be cropped, flipped,
  rotated, or have their shape distorted or changed. Read the page's current text before
  publishing: it is the authority, and this summary is not.

  A course video is training material. A thumbnail is that material's cover, on a channel that
  may be monetised, so it is the use closest to the edge of those terms. The cover must not
  suggest that Microsoft produced, sponsored or endorsed the course. GraphL's FULL COURSE badge and
  the "data engineering" line are the course's own identity, and nothing on it says otherwise.

  `--mark tile` (public/favicon.svg, this repo's own mark) needs none of this.
